archetype.label: Five-Tool Freak
archetype.desc: Does everything, the face of the game

phoneInbox.text: Been riding the bench again man. Thinking about asking for a trade. What would you do?

choices.label: Be honest with him
choices.reply: You deserve at bats mate. If he won't give them, go get them somewhere

choices.label: Tell him to stop whining
choices.reply: Outwork him then. Nobody owes you a lineup spot

choices.label: Dodge the question
choices.reply: Tough one bro. Sleep on it

phoneInbox.text: Watched you on TV last night. Still remember you at 14 refusing to leave the cage after closing. Proud of you kid.

choices.label: Thank him properly
choices.reply: Everything started with you coach. Tickets for you whenever you want, for life

phoneInbox.text: Winter caravan. Five towns in four days, schools and hospitals, a lot of handshakes. You in?

choices.label: All five towns
choices.reply: All five. Load me up with signed balls

choices.label: One stop
choices.reply: I can do one stop, the rest of the week is family

phoneInbox.text: The whole family wants playoff tickets. All fourteen of us. Your uncle says he's bringing a sign.

choices.label: Buy them all
choices.reply: Fourteen tickets, done. Tell him to make the sign big

choices.label: Four tickets, that's it
choices.reply: Four. Everybody else watches at the house

phoneInbox.text: Settled an hour before my hearing last year. Split the difference and slept fine. Where are you at?

choices.label: Leaning toward settling
choices.reply: Leaning that way. Nobody wins in that room

choices.label: Going all the way
choices.reply: Going in. I want them to say it to my face

phoneInbox.text: We'd love you on the morning show before Game 1. Ten minutes, fire the city up.

choices.label: Do it, hype the city
choices.reply: I'm in. Let's get this town loud

choices.label: Decline, locked in
choices.reply: Locked in this week. After we win
